task.title: Club events page
task.html:
Club
  • Home
  • Events
  • Contacts

Events
task.description: The platform sets an array events of objects { title, category, date }. 1) Menu: a click on .menu-toggle toggles the class is-open on #site-nav and the button's aria-expanded; Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to the button. 2) Theme: on load from localStorage under the key "theme" - "dark" gives body the class theme-dark and .theme-toggle aria-pressed="true"; a click toggles the theme and saves "dark" or "light". 3) renderEvents(list): clears #events, for every event - an article.event with data-category, an h3 and a p.event__date; #events-status shows "Shown: N" or "No events in this category yet". All are shown on load. 4) One handler on .filters: a button with data-filter shows the events of that category (all - all of them), aria-pressed="true" only on the pressed button.

tests.name: Menu: a click opens it, aria-expanded="true"
Menu: a second click closes it
tests.fail: Toggle the state, do not only open.

tests.name: Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the button
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector(".menu-toggle").click(); document.querySelector("#site-nav a").focus(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true })); return !document.querySelector("#site-nav").classList.contains("is-open") && document.querySelector(".menu-toggle").getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "false" && document.activeElement === document.querySelector(".menu-toggle"); })()
tests.fail: On Escape: close the menu and menuToggle.focus();

tests.name: The default theme is light
tests.fail: Without a saved value the theme is light.

tests.name: A saved dark theme is restored
tests.fail: On load read localStorage.getItem("theme") and apply the theme.

tests.name: A click turns on the dark theme and saves "dark"
On load all 4 events are shown and "Shown: 4"
tests.fail: At the end of the code call renderEvents(events);

tests.name: Card: h3, p.event__date and data-category
tests.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelectorAll("#events article.event")[1]; return c.querySelector("h3").textContent === "Flexbox in practice" && c.querySelector("p.event__date").textContent === "10 March" && c.dataset.category === "css"; })()

tests.name: aria-pressed="true" only on the pressed button
tests.fail: For every button: other.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(other === button));

tests.name: The "All" button brings back all events
tests.fail: For all, show the whole events array.

tests.name: Empty category: a message and an empty list
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-filter="js"]').click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#events article.event").length === 0 && document.querySelector("#events-status").textContent === "No events in this category yet"; })()
tests.fail: If list.length === 0 - the text "No events in this category yet".

tests.name: Another data set
tests.fail: Use the events array and the list parameter, not ready-made values.

tests.name: The program runs without errors
tests.fail: Read the error text; a common cause is null from a typo in a selector.

hints: Menu: nav.classList.toggle("is-open", isOpen) and aria-expanded via String(isOpen).
renderEvents clears the container first: container.textContent = "";
Filter: const button = event.target.closest("[data-filter]"); if (!button) { return; }
An empty list - a separate text in #events-status.

wrong_solutions.mistake: aria-pressed is not removed from other buttons
the filter hides cards via style

questions.question: Which keyword makes a function available to other modules? Type the word.
What is true about modules?

Each file has its own variables
They work when the page is opened via file://

questions.question: Why does initContactForm start with if (!form) { return; }?
options: main.js is connected to all pages, but the form exists on only one - without the check there would be a null error
So that the form is submitted

questions.question: What should you do after closing the menu with Escape?

Scroll the page to the top

questions.question: What is progressive enhancement?

Animations turn on one by one

questions.question: On GitHub Pages js/Menu.js does not load, although everything worked locally. The likely cause?

questions.explanation: Menu.js and menu.js are different files on the server.
